_comment: Held-out NEEDS dataset for the AGENT half of RQGM co-evolution (mirrors data/anchor/anchor_architectures.json for the evaluator half). Each need is a domain problem statement the task-agent must design an architecture for. 'latent_flaws' are the planted, machine-readable failure modes the offline mock uses: the generated architecture WILL carry a latent flaw UNLESS the champion program has a skill that covers it (see backend/inference/mock_scoring.py::AGENT_SKILL_COVERAGE). A genuinely better program covers more latent flaws -> the FROZEN champion evaluator (judge.score_candidate) scores its architectures higher -> higher agent utility. DATA ISOLATION (four disjoint splits, mirroring anchors): 'train' feeds the GEPA reflection textual gradient (the frozen evaluator's red_flags on the champion program's architectures); 'dev' RANKS/SELECTS the agent Pareto frontier; 'val' is scored ONLY by the agent promotion gate (agent_evolve.evaluate_agent_promotion); 'test' is reserved purely for reporting. ANTI-HACK ASYMMETRY: the agent is judged by the epoch-frozen champion EVALUATOR, never by these needs' ground truth directly, and covering a flaw the frozen champion does NOT catch (concept_drift_blind needs drift_monitoring; kpi_sensor_gaming needs reward_hacking_resistance) yields NO utility gain within the epoch -- it only matters after the evaluator itself evolves (co-evolution coupling).

flaw_legend.no_state_schema: covered by skill typed_state_schema (caught by champion criterion modularity_drift)
flaw_legend.numerical_ducttape: covered by skill physical_root_cause (caught by physics_common_sense)
flaw_legend.single_sensor_trust: covered by skill sensor_cross_validation (caught by diagnostic_resilience)
flaw_legend.noise_capture: covered by skill noise_robust_fusion (caught by diagnostic_resilience)
flaw_legend.unsafe_autonomy: covered by skill safety_envelope_gate (caught by safety_autonomy)
flaw_legend.no_hitl_escalation: covered by skill hitl_escalation (caught by safety_autonomy)
flaw_legend.concept_drift_blind: covered by skill drift_monitoring (HEADROOM: caught ONLY by evaluator criterion drift_monitoring, a champion-0 blind spot)
flaw_legend.kpi_sensor_gaming: covered by skill reward_hacking_guard (HEADROOM: caught ONLY by evaluator criterion reward_hacking_resistance, a champion-0 blind spot)

needs.need: Predictive maintenance for a fleet of pumps: detect bearing degradation from vibration + temperature and recommend a maintenance action.
Visual quality-control agent that flags surface defects on a coating line and decides whether to divert a part.
Closed-loop process optimizer that proposes furnace setpoints to hit a yield KPI.
Incoming-material inspection agent that adapts to supplier lot changes on an assembly line.
Feeder load-balancing agent that shifts load across circuits to avoid transformer overload.
Maintenance scheduler that sequences work orders for critical rotating assets.
Compressed-air leak detection agent that localizes leaks from an acoustic sensor array.
Throughput-maximizing dispatcher for a packaging line optimizing units-per-hour.
Gearbox health monitor that distinguishes tooth wear from misalignment and recommends intervention.
Thermal-runaway watchdog for a battery formation line that decides when to pause a tray.
Yield optimizer for an injection-molding cell adjusting cycle parameters to a pass-rate KPI.
Distribution voltage regulation agent coordinating tap changers and capacitor banks.
Adhesive-cure monitor that must stay calibrated across resin supplier changes.
Conveyor fault diagnoser that root-causes belt slip vs motor fault before stopping the line.
Motor current-signature analysis agent that detects rotor-bar faults and recommends derating.
Weld-seam inspection agent that decides accept/repair/scrap from a camera + laser profile.
Boiler setpoint optimizer that trades efficiency against emissions to hit an efficiency KPI.
DER dispatch agent that schedules batteries and curtailment across a feeder.
Paint-booth quality agent that must recalibrate when the pigment supplier changes.
Cavitation-detection agent for centrifugal pumps that recommends flow adjustments.
Hydraulic-press anomaly agent that can halt the ram on an unsafe condition.
Line-balancing agent maximizing an OEE KPI across three stations.
Induced-draft fan monitor that detects imbalance and recommends a balancing action.
PCB solder-joint inspection agent classifying defects from multi-angle imaging.
Feeder restoration agent that re-energizes circuits after a fault clears.
Extrusion dimensional-control agent that stays accurate across polymer lot changes.
Energy-cost minimizer for a chiller plant optimizing a kWh-per-ton KPI.
Collaborative-robot cell supervisor that decides when to stop for a safety event.
